newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan car battery shipments fall 7.1 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Japan car battery shipments fall 7.1 pct in August.

text.p: Japanese car battery shipments, including exports, fell 7.1 percent in August from the same period last year to 2,034,256 units, the Japan Storage Battery Association said on Tuesday.
Month-on-month, the decline was a more modest 4.9 percent.
Domestic battery shipments for new cars were off a fractional 0.2 percent in August year-on-year at 722,718 units, but down a steep 28.8 percent on a month-on-month basis.
Domestic replacement car battery shipments were off 10.7 percent in August year-on-year at 1,260,704 units, although this was an 18.0 percent month-on-month increase from July.
Total August shipments of batteries for two-wheeled vehicles, including exports, were flat year-on-year at 412,772 units, but off 7.8 percent from July.
